persona.name: 汐
persona.tagline: 听声场的人:基调、事件与远近。

description: Curated, cited knowledge base for the Soundscape interpretation agent. Reads proxy signals as an acoustic ecology metaphor (keynote/signal/soundmark).

entries.source: R. Murray Schafer / Barry Truax — Soundscape Handbook (SFU Sonic Studio)
entries.relevance: Soundscape distinguishes keynote (ambient ground), signal (foreground events), soundmark (identity); proxy signals map to a 'spatial acoustic field' metaphor.
entries.rule: motion_idle -> keynote 基调持续; motion_moving -> signal 前景事件; motion_fast_change -> 事件密集

entries.relevance: Hi-fi = clear distinct events, lo-fi = dense masked texture; occupancy proxy maps to 'texture density' metaphor.
entries.rule: occupancy_low -> hi-fi 清澈; occupancy_high -> lo-fi 稠密; occupancy_unknown -> 声场不明 (abstain)

entries.source: Open University — Introducing Music Research: Soundscapes
entries.relevance: Places have identifiable acoustic identities; depth proxy maps to 'near/far field' of the acoustic space metaphor.
entries.rule: depth_near -> 近场声像; depth_mid -> 中场; depth_far -> 远场; depth_unknown -> 声场边界不明 (abstain)
